entries.54f8cb1f8e6290e5: Based on the Sugimura Group Medium-Term Management Plan covering fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2026, the company is developing its business with the expansion of cargo handled, the expansion of bases, improvement of productivity, development of human resources and sustainability initiatives as issues. Because it reached the targets set out in the plan in the previous consolidated fiscal year, it is now advancing consideration toward formulating a new medium-term management plan, and states that for the time being it will continue to address the issues in the current plan. As its management philosophy, it sets out "Always anticipate customer needs and meet their expectations," "Contribute to society through logistics operations" and "Return affluence to shareholders and employees."
